# ngrok documentation: Share Localhost

> Every page in the Share Localhost section of the ngrok docs (15 pages). Each link points to the page's Markdown version.

## Share Localhost

- [Share Localhost Overview](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/overview.md): Use ngrok to instantly share your local development server with anyone on the internet for demos, testing, and collaboration.
- [Share Localhost Quickstart](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/quickstart.md): Install the ngrok CLI, connect it to your account, and put an app running on your machine online at a public URL you can share.
- [How Sharing Localhost Works](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/tunnels.md): Learn what happens when you put a service running on your machine on the internet, and what that means for access and security.

## Use Cases

- [Test Webhooks Locally](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/webhooks.md): Receive webhooks from third-party services on your machine, inspect and replay their payloads, and verify their signatures.
- [Test Mobile Apps Locally](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/mobile.md): Point a mobile app on a device or emulator at a backend running on your machine, using a stable public HTTPS URL from ngrok.
- [Share Local APIs](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/apis.md): Give teammates and partners a public HTTPS URL for an API running on your machine, then inspect their requests and add authentication.

## Concepts

- [Inspect Traffic and Replay Requests](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/inspection.md): Inspect and replay HTTP requests and responses with ngrok's Traffic Inspector to speed up debugging and development.
- [Authentication](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/auth.md): Make visitors sign in before they reach your local app with the OAuth action, and allow only the specific users you choose.
- [Network Security](https://ngrok.com/docs/share-localhost/security.md): Limit who can reach an app you share with ngrok by IP address or client certificate, and combine those controls on one endpoint.

## Identity & Access

- [Identity and Access Management Overview](https://ngrok.com/docs/iam/index.md): Learn about ngrok's identity and access management system for managing credentials, enforcing access controls, and federating identity.

## Identity & Access / Principals

- [Users](https://ngrok.com/docs/iam/users.md): Understand how users work in ngrok accounts including authentication, credentials, dashboard access, and multi-account membership.
- [Service Users](https://ngrok.com/docs/iam/service-users.md): Service Users are ngrok service accounts that own credentials independently of a person, so automated systems keep working when people leave.

## Identity & Access / Account Governance

- [Single Sign-On and Provisioning to the ngrok Dashboard](https://ngrok.com/docs/iam/sso.md): Learn how to configure single sign-on for the ngrok dashboard using SAML or OpenID Connect identity providers.
- [Role-Based Access Control](https://ngrok.com/docs/iam/rbac.md): Configure role-based access control in ngrok to restrict actions that users and service users can perform in your account.
- [Account Domain Controls](https://ngrok.com/docs/iam/domain-controls.md): Keep everyone at your organization in one ngrok account with single sign-on by verifying your email domain, and see what changes for users.
